pieces.Text: A burrowing Shaitan Binder Eidolon can pass through dirt, gravel, or other loose or porous solid matter as easily as a fish swims through water.  It cannot use this ability to pass through a solid barrier such as a stone or brick wall.  Its burrowing leaves behind no tunnel or hole, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of its presence.  A move earth spell cast on an area containing a burrowing Eidolon flings the Eidolon back 30 feet, stunning the creature for 1 round unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.
